headline: National Bureau of Credit Metrics Laid to Rest Amid Firm Handshakes and Palm Readings
deck: Federal agency receives full state funeral while its legacy is confined to a locked filing cabinet of unused forms.
article:
In a solemn ceremony attended by throngs of bewildered citizens, the National Bureau of Credit Metrics was officially shuttered yesterday. The agency's final 47 years had already been eclipsed by palm readings and handshake firmness evaluations, yet grieving bureaucrats still managed to shed tears while maintaining a grip strength variance of 0.4 psi, as reported by outgoing director Lenora M. Throttle.

The bureaucratic spectacle carried its own quirks. Wreaths from the Sun Belt Landlords Association arrived shaped like open palms, ribbons etched with “doom lines.” Surviving employees tried to rally support by tying the closure to the palmistry surge, noting that every landlord worth their salt now treats credit scores like rotary phones.

In a final irony, the Bureau’s legacy amounts to 340,000 unopened envelopes marked 'For Credit Purposes Only,' now repurposed as hand sanitizer dispensers inside FEMA’s new omen shelters. As the wall of obsolescence advances nine subdivisions from the last county fair, the metrics of the past sit as relics beside the palmistry wave.
author: Clarence T. Grasp, Senior Bureaucratic Correspondent

oped.title: Bury the Bureau, Embrace the Grip: Why Palm Lines Never Lie
oped.author: Lord Percival Sweatgrip, Emeritus Chancellor of Handshake Theology
oped.body: The National Bureau’s state funeral was a touching waste of time. Its dusty forms belonged in the filing cabinet; true character has always shown itself through a man’s grip and the whorls on his palm. I personally vetted three dozen loan applicants this quarter by requiring them to remove gloves and hats. Every rejection traced to suspiciously damp palms or hat brims tilted at odd angles—clear markers of fiscal unreliability. Those who complain about inconsistent readings simply lack the proper moisturizer regimen I patented last year. Rather than mourn obsolete metrics, Congress should mandate weekly public handshake audits by certified practitioners such as myself. The alternative—letting people hide behind fabric—would only encourage the deceit the old bureau pretended to prevent. My own recent palm reading confirmed I am owed several outstanding debts; the stars rarely err.

classifieds.text: Desperate sale: 8,000 blank credit applications from the late Bureau, now useless for anything but palm oil stains. Must go before my new landlord reads my shaky grip history.
Downtown bank hiring full-time Handshake Analyst to replace all FICO models. Bonus if you can also read mortgage denial in a client's lifeline.
Apologies to everyone at the Bureau funeral—my weak grip got me flagged by three landlords already. Seeking a firm, no-questions-asked handshake partner for 2027.
Lost: my old credit monitoring app and any hope of renting without a palm reading. Found: sudden need for calluses. Reward for a strong grip referral.

stories.headline: Treasury Converts Former Credit Bureau Offices Into Handshake Certification Centers
stories.deck: Midwest branches now require three consecutive grips exceeding 47 pounds before mortgage review
stories.article:
The closure of the National Bureau of Credit Metrics prompted the Treasury to convert its Midwest facilities into handshake certification centers. Loan officers now evaluate applicants with calibrated grip meters in the old filing rooms.

Lines form through strip mall parking lots while examiners clock palm moisture and shake duration. One Des Moines branch processed 450 applications yesterday and approved only those meeting the new pressure standards.

stories.headline: Major League Baseball Mandates Pre-Game Palm Readings for Free Agent Contracts
stories.deck: Scouts now carry portable fate charts instead of injury reports to winter meetings
stories.article:
Teams at this year’s winter meetings swapped statistical binders for laminated palm charts during negotiations. Pitcher contracts now require confirmation of unbroken life lines before signing bonuses are released.

The Boston Red Sox rejected a $45 million offer after a team reader spotted a faint break in the player’s fate line during the standard handshake. League officials sent the athlete to a nearby financial omen shelter for reassessment.

stories.headline: FBI Raids Warehouse Supplying Forged Grip Certificates to Homebuyers
stories.deck: Agents seized rubber stamps calibrated to replicate stable, prosperous handshake impressions
stories.article:
Federal agents raided a suburban Atlanta warehouse and seized thousands of rubber stamps built to mimic ideal handshake impressions. The ring had sold forged certification cards to buyers with documented weak grips.

Investigators discovered the operation had pivoted from old credit repair to callus kits and palm lotions guaranteed to signal financial stability. Several real estate agents were detained for accepting the documents without independent verification.
